column18: Mappable: No. Mediation Inconsistency: The range of DOLCE's generic-location-of is particular. The range of BFO's Relational Ontology's (RO) located_of is Continuant. The domain of DOLCE's has-quality is particular. This inconsistency is a result of the OWL DisjointClasses class axiom. In this equivalence relation.
